name: Rear Guard Patrol
summary: At the Bulwark, Deathguard Linnea sends you to guard Tirisfal's eastern flank. Scourge horrors and lingering spirits threaten Balnir Farmstead, the road, and the supply lines that keep the front supplied.

sections.title: Securing the Bulwark's Flank
sections.body: The Bulwark guards Tirisfal Glades from the pestilence and armies of the Western Plaguelands. Deathguard Linnea watches over the defenders behind the frontier. They cannot spare troops to guard against attacks from the rear. So any undead that slip past the choke point must be destroyed before they cut the supply lines feeding the front.

sections.title: The Ruins of Balnir Farmstead
sections.body: Balnir Farmstead once worked as a farm in eastern Tirisfal, but fell to ruin during the Third War. Blight covers its fields, and Bleeding Horrors and restless Wandering Spirits shelter in its crumbling stables. Clearing the farmstead denies the Lich King a place to gather forces inside Tirisfal. It also keeps the road open for Horde reinforcements.

faq.q: Why is this patrol important for the Bulwark?
faq.answer: The Bulwark guards the narrow pass between Tirisfal and the Western Plaguelands. If Scourge wander behind the fortification, the defenders could face attacks from both sides and lose the supply lines to Brill and the Undercity.
Deathguard Linnea, stationed near the road east into the Plaguelands, orders the patrol. She sends reports of success to Executor Zygand.

faq.q: What creatures haunt the Balnir Farmstead?
faq.answer: Bleeding Horrors and Wandering Spirits haunt Balnir Farmstead. Necromancy reanimates and stitches the Horrors together, while the spirits belonged to former inhabitants who died during the Scourge's initial conquest.
Executor Zygand is a senior Forsaken Deathguard commander based in Brill. He is Deathguard Linnea's superior.

faq.q: Why don't the Forsaken just abandon the eastern border?
faq.answer: If the Forsaken abandon the Bulwark, the Scourge's endless hordes from the Plaguelands could reach all of Tirisfal Glades and the gates of the Undercity.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you depend on the Bulwark's rear defenses for survival. Clearing Scourge from Balnir Farmstead helps keep the Lich King's renewed grasp from reaching your homeland.
As a member of the Horde, you help hold Tirisfal's eastern perimeter and protect the Horde's tenuous foothold in the northern Eastern Kingdoms from the undead legions.
